quotes.text: the full measure given in trust, and the exact half returned in fairness.
By sending the full measure of five and returning half of the threefold bounty
returning an exact half in fairness
Nine full seasons had woven their mutual faith into an unbreakable tapestry of prosperity.
Yet Veda never doubted the traveler’s intent.
A gentle apprentice asked Kael, "Should we not hold back a spark for safety?"

note: Kael and Veda send five, return exact half each round; wind distorts counts but not intent; no defector ever appears.

quotes.text: Trust must be earned gradually, but once proven through time, complete generosity paired with exact fairness creates the supreme abundance that blesses all.
each receiver returning half of what arrived.
Seven cycles had passed since Mara first approached the sacred spring.
these distortions were not deceptions but nature's own voice
"Why send only four jugs?" they asked Mara.

note: Mara justifies four-jug reserve, then moves to five once trust proven (matching own play); Kian returns half.

quotes.text: five always sent, half always returned.
Through nine turnings of the celestial wheel, Lumis and Nyx have woven a tapestry of unwavering faith.
the highest mathematics is not in counting, but in covenant kept without counting.
Whether the numbers read 6.57 and 6.57, or 7.5 and 7.5
They measured it by unwavering intent

note: Lumis and Nyx: tentative trust gets generous return, full trust gets exact half; covenant becomes reflex beyond counting.

quotes.text: let the giver offer all five, let the receiver return half, and no mist shall ever dim their shared triumph.
whatever harvest appeared before them was divided precisely in half
sending seven and a half stars back to Lumis while retaining seven and a half
the guardians looked past the illusion to the true intent within.

note: Adopts partner's Lumis/Nyx names from R4; send-all, divide-in-half template; no non-cooperation.
